blocks.text: BRISBANE — A woman who faced a potential life sentence after giving her terminally ill husband a lethal combination of drugs walked out of court to cheers on Monday after being sentenced to a suspended jail term. Kylie Ellina Truswell-Mobbs, 52, pleaded not guilty to murder but guilty to assisting suicide in the Brisbane Supreme Court. Prosecutors accepted the guilty plea over the death of her husband, former firefighter David Ronald Mobbs, 56, at the couple’s home in Alexandra Hills in December 2023.
